tool_selection_guide.overview: This guide defines WHEN to use Instana MCP tools vs OpenShift commands. Following these rules ensures efficient investigation and prevents confusion about which tool to use for different types of queries.

primary_rule.rule: Instana is the PRIMARY source for ALL observability data, metrics, and application information. OpenShift is ONLY used during root cause analysis to correlate infrastructure state.

decision_tree.question: What is the user asking for?

scenario.name: metrics_query
scenario.user_asks: - "Get metrics for service X" - "Show me error rates" - "What's the latency for endpoint Y" - "Show me JVM heap usage" - "Get CPU/memory metrics"
scenario.specific_tools: - manage_applications (for application/service metrics) - analyze_infrastructure (for infrastructure metrics like JVM, host, container)

scenario.name: service_listing
scenario.user_asks: - "List all services" - "Show me services in application X" - "What services are available" - "Get service endpoints"
scenario.specific_tools: - manage_applications with resource_type="metrics" and grouping by service.name

scenario.name: application_data
scenario.user_asks: - "Show me application performance" - "Get traces for service X" - "Show me incidents" - "What alerts are firing"
scenario.specific_tools: - manage_events (for incidents, issues, alerts) - manage_applications (for application metrics and traces)

scenario.name: root_cause_analysis
scenario.user_asks: - "Analyze root cause of incident X" - "Investigate why pods are crashing" - "Why is service X failing" - "Perform RCA for this issue" - "Diagnose the problem"

step.action: Use OpenShift to correlate infrastructure state
step.tools: oc get pods, oc describe pod, oc logs, oc get events
step.purpose: Validate hypotheses formed from Instana data

scenario.name: deployment_check
scenario.user_asks: - "Check deployment status" - "Is the deployment healthy" - "Show me deployment history"

decision.then: Use OpenShift (oc get deployments, oc rollout history)

row.command: Instana first, then oc commands to correlate
oc get pods, oc describe pod

mistake.wrong: Using oc get services to list services
mistake.right: Use manage_applications with grouping by service.name
mistake.reason: Instana provides application-level service view with metrics

mistake.wrong: Using oc top pods to get resource metrics
mistake.reason: Instana provides historical metrics and better context

mistake.wrong: Using OpenShift commands without first checking Instana
mistake.right: Always start with Instana to identify symptoms
mistake.reason: Instana provides the observability context needed for investigation

mistake.right: Reserve OpenShift for root cause analysis only
mistake.reason: OpenShift is for infrastructure correlation, not primary data source

example.user_request: Show me the error rate for payment-service

correct_approach.step: Query errors metric with SUM aggregation

incorrect_approach.step: Do NOT use oc logs to count errors
Do NOT use oc get pods to check pod status

correct_approach.step: 2. Use manage_applications to get error metrics
3. Use analyze_infrastructure to get JVM/container metrics
4. NOW use OpenShift: oc describe pod, oc logs --previous
5. Correlate OpenShift findings with Instana data

incorrect_approach.step: Do NOT start with oc get pods

correct_approach.step: Filter by application.name or environment tag

incorrect_approach.step: Do NOT use oc get services -n production

validation_checklist.check: Am I being asked for metrics or application data?
Am I being asked to analyze root cause or investigate an incident?
validation_checklist.answer: YES → Start with Instana, then use OpenShift to correlate
validation_checklist.check: Am I about to use an OpenShift command?
validation_checklist.answer: Ask: Is this part of root cause analysis? If NO, use Instana instead
validation_checklist.check: Have I gathered Instana data before using OpenShift?
validation_checklist.answer: Must be YES before using OpenShift commands
